notes: Verifies the on-disk JSON key names are snake_case ('pack_managed' etc.) per the MSC config contract, same custom-CodingKeys convention as P0.15. The exact substrings (including the space before ':') reflect Swift JSONEncoder's .prettyPrinted output formatting specifically — what must be preserved in the Rust port is the snake_case KEY NAMES themselves, not this exact whitespace, which is an artifact of Swift's pretty-printer rather than part of the wire contract.
